content.text: filled with the spirit of wisdom, Ex. 28:3. filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, Ex. 31:3 (35:31). do them; for this is your wisdom, Deut. 4:6. Joshua … was full of the spirit of wisdom, Deut. 34:9. wisdom of God was in him, 1 Kgs. 3:28. God gave Solomon wisdom, 1 Kgs. 4:29. Solomon exceeded all … for wisdom, 1 Kgs. 10:23 (2 Chr. 9:22). With the ancient is wisdom, Job 12:12. where shall wisdom be found, Job 28:12. fear of the Lord, that is wisdom, Job 28:28 (Ps. 111:10; Prov. 9:10). multitude of years should teach wisdom, Job 32:7. mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, Ps. 37:30. him that by wisdom made the heavens, Ps. 136:5. know wisdom and instruction, Prov. 1:2. fools despise wisdom and instruction, Prov. 1:7. Lord giveth wisdom, Prov. 2:6. Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, Prov. 3:13. Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom, Prov. 4:7. wisdom is better than rubies, Prov. 8:11. mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom, Prov. 10:31. scorner seeketh wisdom, and findeth it not, Prov. 14:6. better is it to get wisdom than gold, Prov. 16:16. He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul, Prov. 19:8. Through wisdom is an house builded, Prov. 24:3. Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father, Prov. 29:3. rod and reproof give wisdom, Prov. 29:15. man’s wisdom maketh his face to shine, Eccl. 8:1. Wisdom is better than strength, Eccl. 9:16. spirit of wisdom and understanding, Isa. 11:2 (2 Ne. 21:2). wisdom of their wise men shall perish, Isa. 29:14 (1 Cor. 1:19; 2 Ne. 27:26). wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times, Isa. 33:6. Let not the wise man glory in his wisdom, Jer. 9:23. in all matters of wisdom and understanding … he found them ten times better, Dan. 1:20. he giveth wisdom unto the wise, Dan. 2:21. wisdom, like the wisdom of the gods, was found in him, Dan. 5:11.

wisdom is justified of her children, Matt. 11:19 (Luke 7:35). she came … to hear the wisdom of Solomon, Matt. 12:42 (Luke 11:31). Whence hath this man this wisdom, Matt. 13:54 (Mark 6:2). turn … disobedient to the wisdom of the just, Luke 1:17. child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom, Luke 2:40. Jesus increased in wisdom, Luke 2:52. I will give you a mouth and wisdom, Luke 21:15. they were not able to resist the wisdom, Acts 6:10. Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, Acts 7:22. depth … of the wisdom and knowledge of God, Rom. 11:33. preach the gospel: not with wisdom of words, 1 Cor. 1:17. I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, 1 Cor. 1:19. hath not God made foolish the wisdom of this world, 1 Cor. 1:20 (3:19). Christ … the wisdom of God, 1 Cor. 1:24. we speak the wisdom of God in a mystery, 1 Cor. 2:7. to one is given by the Spirit the word of wisdom, 1 Cor. 12:8 (D&C 46:17). not with fleshly wisdom, but by the grace of God, 2 Cor. 1:12. he hath abounded toward us in all wisdom, Eph. 1:8. God … give unto you the spirit of wisdom, Eph. 1:17. known by the church the manifold wisdom of God, Eph. 3:10. filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom, Col. 1:9. In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge, Col. 2:3. word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom, Col. 3:16. Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, Col. 4:5. If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, James 1:5 (D&C 42:68; JS—H 1:11). wisdom that is from above is first pure, James 3:17. Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, Rev. 5:12.

done in the wisdom of him who knoweth all things, 2 Ne. 2:24. their wisdom is foolishness, 2 Ne. 9:28. puffed up because of their … wisdom, 2 Ne. 9:42. spirit of wisdom and understanding, 2 Ne. 21:2. see fit in mine own wisdom to reveal, 2 Ne. 27:22. those who hearken unto my precepts … learn wisdom, 2 Ne. 28:30. he counseleth in wisdom, Jacob 4:10. tell you these things that ye may learn wisdom, Mosiah 2:17. Spirit … guide you in wisdom’s paths, Mosiah 2:36. he has all wisdom, Mosiah 4:9 (Alma 26:35). see that all these things are done in wisdom, Mosiah 4:27. learn wisdom in thy youth, Alma 37:35.

as they sought wisdom they might be instructed, D&C 1:26. Seek not for riches but for wisdom, D&C 6:7 (11:7). Be patient, my son, for it is wisdom, D&C 9:3. my wisdom is greater than the cunning of the devil, D&C 10:43. treasure up wisdom in your bosoms, D&C 38:30. bring forth fruits of praise and wisdom, D&C 52:17. their wisdom shall be great, D&C 76:9. shall speak … the words of wisdom, D&C 78:2. wisdom receiveth wisdom, D&C 88:40. teach one another words of wisdom, D&C 88:118 (109:7). shall find wisdom and great treasures of knowledge, D&C 89:19. many … are seeking diligently to learn wisdom, D&C 97:1. show forth my wisdom through the weak things, D&C 124:1. learn wisdom by humbling himself and calling upon the Lord, D&C 136:32.
my wisdom excelleth them all, Abr. 3:21.
